Careers

We’re building the future of network security.

Are you a builder, too?

At Zero Networks we believe network security should be radically simple. It should be automated, not manual. Deployments should take hours, not months. And scale should be achieved within minutes, not years. Zero Networks leads a paradigm shift addressing some of cybersecurity’s biggest challenges. If you’re a builder passionate about leaving your mark in this journey, you belong with us.

Our Values

Friendship

We check our egos at the door and work towards a common goal: to succeed together. Our relationships come before any deliverables.

Growth

Critical thinkers of all stripes thrive here. Support is there every step of the way as you develop and reach new heights.

Raising the bar

We love a challenge and strive for excellence. Always.

Transparency

Come as you are and ask hard questions. Learn by making mistakes. Analyze failure and celebrate success.

Perseverance

Do today what other people aren’t willing to do. Tomorrow you’ll be able to do what other people can’t.
